content.short: Epigeon is an end-to-end encrypted Web3 messaging service.
content.description: Epigeon provides a fully decentralized, end-to-end encrypted messaging solution for Web3. It lets you securely deliver messages to specific wallet addresses, including smart contract owners and NFT holders, without relying on centralized intermediaries. Anyone with a wallet can be reached through Epigeon, enabling targeted outreach and ongoing conversations. After you connect, you can continue the dialogue in Epigeon’s built-in chat interface, keeping communications private and under your control as your on-chain interactions unfold.
